stopReason: A new frozen-contract dependency-direction blocker was found during the bounded closeout audit. Development and test execution stopped instead of opening another fix-and-retest loop.

observed: src/compiler/orchestration/pipeline-orchestrator.ts:474 derives the Pipeline isolation decision from that Mutation-specific path helper
blockers.impact: Pipeline and its kernel-facing coordinator reverse-depend on Mutation-specific code, contrary to the frozen one-way dependency rule. A path-shaped workspace also substitutes for an explicit, authority-bound isolation capability.
blockers.requiredResolution: Replace the reverse dependency with a neutral, non-forgeable isolation capability/context seam owned by Pipeline or Verification. Semantic Mutation may bind and pass that capability one way; ordinary callers and workspace path shape must not mint it. Update the contract test that currently freezes the Mutation-specific helper dependency.
